description: Reconciliation & index-hygiene signals (Loki-derived). Born from the 2026-07-16 #224 stage-1 incident: a non-convergent ignore-reconcile loop ran for weeks (49 reconciles/50min, ~40 cross-branch point-deletes/hour) with zero dashboard visibility — every signal on this board existed only in logs. Thresholds encode the incident signature.

panels.title: ignore_sync runs (1h)
panels.description: Reconciliation passes across all tenants in the last hour. A handful per real ignore-file edit is normal; a steady stream means a NON-CONVERGENT loop (incident signature: 49/50min reporting an identical stale count).

panels.title: Fallback point-deletes (1h)
panels.description: delete_points_by_filter fallback firings. Post-#278 D2 the generation-wiping case is guarded (skipped with a debug log), so what remains here is the orphan sweep this fallback exists for — ambient rate measured ~30/h from watcher deletes of never-indexed artifacts in active dev repos. Thresholds sit ABOVE ambient: a jump past them means either mass on-disk deletions or a new generation-blind delete path (the #224 incident ran ~40/h of REAL point wipes on top of ambient).

panels.title: Walk failures — D4 guard (24h)
panels.description: "walk found 0 eligible files but N are indexed" — the empty-walk safety net (#278 D4) refusing a mass delete. ANY firing means a project walk is broken (unmounted tree, worktree path resolving wrong, ignore file excluding everything) and that tenant is not being reconciled.

panels.title: ignore_watch triggers (1h)
panels.description: "ignore file changed" watcher firings. Before #278 D3 the mtime cache was keyed by basename, so any of a project's hundreds of nested ignore files re-fired reconciliation (~1/min for weeks). More than a few per hour with no real ignore edits = the amplifier is back.

panels.title: ignore_sync runs by tenant
panels.description: Reconciliation passes per tenant. A flat repeating rate for one tenant with identical stale counts (next panel) is the non-convergence signature.

panels.title: Stale / missing flagged per reconcile
panels.description: Counts each pass reports. Healthy: spikes that DRAIN to zero. A constant plateau (e.g. "5 stale" forever, or the standing "55 missing" churn tracked in #279) = the diff and its remedy disagree and the set never converges.

targets.expr: max by (tenant) (max_over_time({container="wqm-memexd"} |= "[ignore_sync]" |= " stale," | regexp "\\[ignore_sync\\] (?P<tenant>\\S+) — (?P<stale>\\d+) stale, (?P<missing>\\d+) missing" | unwrap stale [$__auto]))

max by (tenant) (max_over_time({container="wqm-memexd"} |= "[ignore_sync]" |= " stale," | regexp "\\[ignore_sync\\] (?P<tenant>\\S+) — (?P<stale>\\d+) stale, (?P<missing>\\d+) missing" | unwrap missing [$__auto]))

panels.title: Branch-tag removals (Removed branch)
panels.description: remove_branch_from_tracked_file outcomes — the ONLY code that strips a branch tag from the authority. "row kept" = ref-counted tag drop; "row deleted" = last tag gone, generation removed. A sustained tag-drop rate outside boot windows = something is enqueuing deletes it should not (the #224 loop stripped main from live files ~1/min).

panels.title: Delete guards: preserves, covered & dry-run
panels.description: "Preserving index" = the on-disk guard no-op'ing a delete (pre-stage-3 this ran ~1k/boot forever); "covered" = stage-3 covered-generation deletes enqueued; "stage3-dry" = what WOULD be deleted under policy=dry. Preserves should be rare after stage 3 — a regrowth means new debris is accumulating.

panels.title: Walk failures & reconcile warnings
panels.description: D4 guard firings and ignore_sync skips/failures. Anything here names a tenant whose reconciliation is NOT running — investigate the walk (path mounted? worktree resolved? ignore rules sane?).

panels.title: branch_prune & stage-3 boot summaries
panels.description: One line per boot: how many orphaned branches were pruned, deletes enqueued, and how many were covered-generation candidates (stage 3). Compare consecutive boots — the covered count must shrink toward zero; monotonic growth = new stale generations are being fabricated faster than they drain.

panels.title: Worktree membership enqueues (1h)
panels.description: Baseline-file enqueues the worktree-membership reconcile made in the last hour, tagging a linked worktree's branch onto the shared main index. 0 is normal for repos with no linked worktrees; a value means worktree branches are being (re)tagged on a scan/reindex.

panels.title: Baseline files tagged per interval — by branch (Prometheus counter)
panels.description: increase() of memexd_worktree_membership_enqueued_total{tenant_id,branch} — the daemon counter bumped once per reconcile pass with the number of baseline files enqueued for that worktree branch. Each series is one worktree branch; flat zero when no worktrees are active.

panels.title: Worktree membership events (raw)
panels.description: One line per (worktree, branch) reconcile: how many baseline files were enqueued, under which branch, from which worktree path. The source behind the panels above.

title: WQM — Reconciliation & Index Hygiene
